sources.title: Google Ads HTML5 creative requirements
sources.notes: ZIP packaging, root index.html, ad.size/ad.orientation metadata, and the exact Google-hosted ExitApi script are profile-bound.

sources.title: Google HTML5 ExitApi
sources.notes: Deliberate CTA uses ExitApi.exit(); no MRAID bridge is substituted.

uploadSize.notes: Exact compressed ZIP upload must fit the conservative decimal 5 MB ceiling.

packaging.notes: Deterministic ZIP with index.html at the flat root and no companion game files.

inline.notes: Only the exact declared Google host script is external; every game asset remains inline.

mraid.notes: Google App campaigns use ExitApi, not MRAID.

vendorHost.notes: Deliberate CTA invokes ExitApi.exit() after the trusted user gesture.

autoplay.notes: Local audio and visibility safety policy.

firstClick.notes: Only the authored CTA invokes ExitApi.

viewability.notes: Document visibility controls local lifecycle in the compiled runtime.

orientations.notes: The ad.orientation metadata declares portrait,landscape and QA covers both.

value.instructions: Validate the exact ZIP through the current official Google HTML5/App campaign workflow and physical devices. Check metadata, ExitApi CTA, audio, rotation, and resume. No official validator result is implied.

preview.notes: Official procedure reference only; not executed.

companionAssets.notes: Campaign settings and store destination remain in Google Ads.
